text_block_list.text: The day of the Kokura Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finished her prayers at Dazaifu 
Tenmangu, one of Fukuoka's two great 
sacred sites, Matikanefukukitaru...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She promises that if she safely conquers 
the Kokura Kinen, she and her Trainer will 
celebrate by visiting another sacred spot 
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling even more motivated than before, 
Machikane Fukukitaru headed out to the 
race.
